Cc: security@helion.ai
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr profile - KMS rotation evidence request

Hi David,

We're working through our vendor profile checklist prior to procurement sign-off. A couple of quick asks for Redwood's Vendr/Whistic entry: can you provide a short attestation that your KMS key rotation policy is in place for production secrets used by the inference control plane? Specifically we need:

- Date of last automatic rotation for the production master key (or statement that rotation is delegated to cloud KMS).
- A short statement of the encryption algorithms in use (e.g., AES-256-GCM) and whether envelope encryption is used.
- One artifact showing a recent rotation event or signed log (pdf or txt).

We don't need full logs — a signed summary and the canonical config path in Vendr/OneTrust will suffice. Targeting a 72-hour turnaround for our SOC pre-check.

Thanks,
Anita
Anita Ramesh
Head of Security Ops | Helion Analytics
security@helion.ai

Hi Anita — thanks for the clear checklist. Short summary below; attaching the signed rotation summary and the canonical algorithms list.

- Rotation: primary production master key rotated automatically last on 2026-05-12 (rotation performed by AWS KMS; Redwood uses customer-managed CMKs in dedicated/private deployments and AWS-managed keys for hosted accounts unless a custom CMK is requested).
- Algorithms: AES-256-GCM for data-at-rest envelope encryption; RSA-2048 for key-wrap where applicable. See enc-algorithms-list.txt for details and runtime variants.
- Artifact: vendr-kms-rotation-summary.pdf (signed by security@redwood.ai) — includes rotation event timestamp and hash of the rotation metadata.

Marissa / Karthik — can you confirm Vendr profile links and upload the two artifacts to the Helion Whistic entry and add a note in Vendr indicating the rotation proof? Also, if Helion needs a different format (signed JSON/CSV), flag it and we'll convert.

David
